fullPassage: Imagine following the spirit of a silence vow into daily life. Challenge yourself to spend an entire day saying only what you absolutely must say. It's been widely observed by behavioral psychology experts — and anyone who's ever been on a first date — that we too often tend to treat "conversation" as a game of waiting for our own turn to speak. We miss what's being said because we're mentally rehearsing our next utterance. What if you could eliminate the idea that the next available mini-silence is your next opening to express whatever is in your head? What if you were limited to, say, fifty spoken words tomorrow? I think you'd listen quite differently. You'd attend quite carefully to every word you heard. You'd be attuned to what you must respond to. You might discover that the less you say, the more you hear.

det.tip: attuned to = ~에 주의를 기울여 맞춘. 주파수를 맞추듯 집중

questions.passage: Imagine following the spirit of a silence vow into daily life. Challenge yourself to spend an entire day saying only what you absolutely must say. We too often tend to treat "conversation" as a game of waiting for our own turn to speak. We miss what's being said because we're mentally rehearsing our next utterance. ____. I think you'd listen quite differently.
questions.stem:
주어진 단어를 올바른 순서로 배열하시오. (대소문자 구분 없음, 마침표 생략 가능)
[ what if / you were / limited to / fifty spoken words / tomorrow ]

det.korean: 내일 50개의 말해진 단어로 제한된다면?
det.analysis: ✅ What if you were limited to fifty spoken words tomorrow
det.tip: What if + S + 과거동사: 가정법 과거

accept: What if you were limited to fifty spoken words tomorrow

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 표현을 쓰시오.
"적게 말할수록 더 많이 듣는다."
→ The __________ you say, the more you hear.
(적절한 영어 단어를 쓸 것)

det.korean: 적게 말할수록 더 많이 __________한다.
det.analysis: ✅ less: the less ~, the more ~ 구문
det.tip: the less ~, the more ~: ~할수록 더 ~하다. less = 더 적게

questions.stem:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 **영어** 표현을 쓰시오.
"대화를 자기 차례를 기다리는 게임으로 여기는 경향이 있다."
→ We tend to treat conversation as a game of waiting for our own __________ to speak.
(적절한 영어 단어를 쓸 것)

det.korean: 우리는 대화를 자기 __________을(를) 기다리는 게임으로 여기는 경향이 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ turn: our own turn to speak = 자기 차례
det.tip: turn = 차례. wait for one's turn = 차례를 기다리다
